body:

best

noun(

usAudio 5/best/ukAudio 6/best/



B1

the most excellent in a group of things or people: 

My tastes are simple - I only like the best.

He wanted the best for his children - good schools, a nicehouse, and tripsabroad.

I like all of Hitchcock's movies, but I think "Notorious" is the best.

the best of friends Chris and I are the best of friends(= we are very closefriends).

Best, ...informal

Verb

   Intermediate [...] to the greatestdegree when used as the superlative of adjectivesbeginning with "good" or "well": 

They were the best-dressed couple at the party.

best looking He was voted the best-looking (= most attractive)actor in Hollywood.

as best you canmainly UK



as well as you can: 

It is a difficultpassage, but just translate it as best you can.
